item.title: Ask HN: When you sell your company, do you receive the money with a normal wire?
item.summary: For those who sold their company for a substantial amount, did the money just arrive on your "regular" bank account? Did you arrive in several times? Don't laugh, I'm trying to visualize the moment my startup is sold, and I want simple details like this one. Thank you for sharing your experience Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49310571 Points: 3 # Comments: 2
